verdict.rationale: Veo 3's docs say it natively generates audio, including dialogue, as part of the video. Hands-on community reports corroborate this, praising how well the audio and video match up and saying the voices are on par with dedicated voice models. Missing for 10: no first-party documentation that explicitly describes lip movement synchronized to speech, no documented way to supply your own scripted lines or audio and have characters lip-sync to them, and no detailed hands-on assessment of lip-sync accuracy.
